text: The user is planning to move into a new home soon and needs to set up cable and TV services, and recalled being pre-approved for $400,000 from Wells Fargo before buying the home.
The user is looking forward to finally owning a home after a long process, and is excited about having a backyard like the one at the new home.
The user's zip code is 78749, and the user needs electricity and gas services set up for the new home in addition to cable and TV services.

The assistant listed cable and TV providers for zip code 78749 with approximate starting prices: Spectrum (Charter Communications) from about $49.99/month for TV only, AT&T (including DirecTV) from about $59.99/month for TV only, Google Fiber bundles from about $70/month, Suddenlink from about $40/month for TV only, and Grande Communications from about $40/month for TV only.

The assistant listed electricity providers for zip code 78749, namely TXU Energy, Reliant Energy, Direct Energy, Just Energy and Pulse Power, and named Texas Gas Service as the local gas provider that would set up gas service.
The assistant advised the user to also set up water and waste management services with the City of Austin or the local provider, and to check each provider's website for current pricing.
The user needs to schedule appointments for electricity and gas setup and asked for a time-tracking tool or app to keep track of these appointments and other tasks for the home move.

The assistant suggested Trello, Todoist, Google Keep, AnyList, Moving Day, Cozi and Google Calendar as apps for tracking appointments and tasks during a move, and suggested keeping a moving binder or digital folder for documents and receipts.
The user decided to try Trello for now and also needs to schedule a home insurance policy with Liberty Mutual, asking what to focus on when reviewing the policy documents.

The assistant advised reviewing the Liberty Mutual home insurance policy for coverage limits, deductibles (for example wind, hail and theft), exclusions such as flood and earthquake damage, replacement cost value versus actual cash value, liability limits, personal property coverage, additional living expenses, discounts and the claims process.

The user rented a storage unit from a company on March 1st to store belongings while closing on the house, and needs to finalize the moving details with the storage unit company, including the moving date, truck size and labor assistance.

The assistant gave a five-step approach for confirming moving details with the storage unit company, including questions about the moving date and time, the truck or container size, the number of movers provided, any additional fees, and how to access belongings on moving day.
The assistant advised the user to photograph stored belongings before they are loaded onto the truck and to create an inventory list to keep track of items during the move.

On 20 May 2023 the user said they were thinking of watching more Marvel movies and asked for films similar to Avengers: Endgame, and the assistant recommended Justice League (2017), X-Men: Days of Future Past (2014), The Incredibles (2004) and Incredibles 2 (2018), Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2 (2017), and Captain America: The Winter Soldier (2014).
The assistant also recommended Logan (2017), Doctor Strange (2016), The Avengers (2012), Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse (2018) and Big Hero 6 (2014) as films similar to Avengers: Endgame.

The user has already watched Doctor Strange (2016), which was one of four Marvel movies the user watched recently, and the user wants non-Marvel sci-fi or action films with a similar scale and scope to Avengers: Endgame.

The assistant recommended non-Marvel sci-fi and action films with a similar scale to Avengers: Endgame, including Pacific Rim (2013), Independence Day (1996), The Matrix Reloaded and The Matrix Revolutions (2003), Star Wars: The Last Jedi (2017), Edge of Tomorrow (2014), War of the Worlds (2005), The Fifth Element (1997), I Am Legend (2007), Geostorm (2017) and Oblivion (2013).
The user re-watched Avengers: Endgame on 19 May 2023 and asked for sci-fi or action movies that are not part of the Marvel Cinematic Universe but still offer similar grandeur and epic battles.

The assistant recommended non-MCU films with epic battles, including Pacific Rim: Uprising (2018), Godzilla: King of the Monsters (2019), Blade Runner 2049 (2017), Valerian and the City of a Thousand Planets (2017), The Matrix Revolutions (2003), Edge of Tomorrow (2014), Independence Day: Resurgence (2016), Geostorm (2017), The Cloverfield Paradox (2018) and Alita: Battle Angel (2019).
The user had already seen Pacific Rim: Uprising (2018), one of the assistant's recommendations, and asked for other sci-fi and action movies with a similar scale and grandeur to Avengers: Endgame.

The assistant's next recommendations were Godzilla: King of the Monsters (2019), Valerian and the City of a Thousand Planets (2017), The Matrix Revolutions (2003), Edge of Tomorrow (2014), Independence Day: Resurgence (2016), Geostorm (2017), The Cloverfield Paradox (2018), Alita: Battle Angel (2019), The Meg (2018) and Skyscraper (2018).

The user had already seen some of the recommended films and asked for more movies with a similar blend of sci-fi and action to Edge of Tomorrow (2014), which the user felt has a similar sense of urgency and action to Avengers: Endgame.

The assistant recommended films with a sci-fi and action blend similar to Edge of Tomorrow, including Source Code (2011), Looper (2012), The Tomorrow War (2020), Oblivion (2013), Elysium (2013), Chappie (2015), RoboCop (2014), Ghost in the Shell (2017), Atomic Blonde (2017) and Hotel Artemis (2018).

After saying they had re-watched Avengers: Endgame, which is a Marvel movie, the user asked again for sci-fi and action films with similar grandeur and epic battles, and the assistant repeated Pacific Rim (2013), Independence Day (1996), The Matrix Reloaded, Edge of Tomorrow (2014), Godzilla: King of the Monsters (2019), Valerian (2017), Geostorm (2017), The Cloverfield Paradox (2018), Alita: Battle Angel (2019) and The Meg (2018).

On 22 May 2023 the user, who had re-watched Spider-Man: No Way Home, asked for non-Marvel superhero films, and the assistant recommended The Dark Knight (2008), Wonder Woman (2017), Joker (2019), Hellboy (2004), The Incredibles (2004), Unbreakable (2000), Hancock (2008) and Kick-Ass (2010).

The assistant listed upcoming non-Marvel superhero films as The Flash (2023) starring Ezra Miller, Blue Beetle (2023), and the TV series The Boys (2020), based on the comic book series by Garth Ennis and Darick Robertson.
The user said The Dark Knight (2008) is one of their favorite movies, that they had already seen it, and asked for recent non-Marvel superhero movies from the past few years.

The assistant recommended recent non-Marvel superhero films including Wonder Woman 1984 (2020), Birds of Prey (2020), Shazam! (2019), Bloodshot (2020), Sonic the Hedgehog (2020), The Old Guard (2020), and Black Adam (2022), with The Flash (2023) and Blue Beetle (2023) listed as upcoming.

Shazam! (2019) follows Billy Batson, played by Asher Angel, a 14-year-old foster kid chosen by an ancient wizard, played by Djimon Hounsou, to become the champion of the gods, who becomes an adult superhero played by Zachary Levi when he says the magic word Shazam!.

The assistant described Shazam! as a playful, light-hearted coming-of-age film with humor, heart and action, which shares a similar tone with Spider-Man: No Way Home, though Shazam! is more innocent while No Way Home has a larger scope.

According to the assistant, Zachary Levi's earlier roles included Chuck (2007-2012) as Chuck Bartowski, Tangled (2010) as the voice of Eugene Fitzherbert (Flynn Rider), Thor: The Dark World (2013) as Fandral, Heroes Reborn (2015-2016) as Luke Collins, and American Underdog: The Kurt Warner Story (2021) as Kurt Warner.

The assistant said Shazam! was Zachary Levi's first leading role in a major superhero film, and the user said they did not know Levi was in Tangled, a film they had watched and enjoyed with their family, and planned to pay attention to his voice acting next time.

The assistant said Mark Strong plays Doctor Thaddeus Sivana, a brilliant, wealthy and ruthless scientist obsessed with the magical realm, who was denied access by the Council of Wizards as a child and now wants the powers of the gods, including Shazam, for himself.
The user said they had been watching many movies with complex villains, such as the Joker in The Dark Knight, and asked what Shazam! is trying to say about family and identity.

The assistant said Shazam! presents family as something that can be chosen rather than only born, with foster kid Billy Batson finding belonging with the Vasquez family, and presents identity as shaped by relationships and choices, with vulnerability shown as a strength.

On 21 May 2023 the user asked for healthy lunch ideas that can be reheated for weekly meal planning, and the assistant suggested Lentil Soup, a Chicken and Rice Bowl, and a Quinoa and Black Bean Bowl topped with diced chicken, avocado and salsa.

The assistant also suggested reheatable lunches including a Roasted Veggie Wrap, Veggie and Bean Chili, Grilled Veggie and Goat Cheese Sandwich, Korean-Style Chicken and Veggies, Indian-Style Lentil Curry, Mexican Chicken and Sweet Potato, Minestrone Soup, Chicken and Vegetable Stew and Butternut Squash Soup.
The user has a new Instant Pot and asked for soup and stew recipes designed specifically for pressure cooking.

The assistant recommended Instant Pot recipes including Creamy Tomato Soup (10 minutes), Lentil Soup (20 minutes), Chicken Tortilla Soup (10 minutes), Butternut Squash Soup blended with coconut milk (10 minutes), Beef Stew (30 minutes), Chana Masala (10 minutes), Korean Chicken Stew (Jjimdak) (20 minutes) and Mexican Black Bean Soup (10 minutes).

The assistant's Instant Pot Creamy Tomato Soup uses 2 tablespoons olive oil, 1 onion, 3 cloves garlic, 2 cups diced tomatoes, 1 cup chicken or veggie broth, 1/2 cup heavy cream and 1 teaspoon dried basil, cooked at high pressure for 10 minutes with a 10-minute natural pressure release.

The assistant advised using the Saute function to brown the onions and garlic before adding liquids to prevent burning, and letting the pressure release naturally for 10-15 minutes before quick-releasing any remaining pressure.
The user said they were particularly interested in the Korean Chicken Stew (Jjimdak) and asked for its ingredients, instructions, and recommended brands of Korean chili flakes and gochujang.

The assistant's Korean Chicken Stew recipe calls for 1 lb boneless, skinless chicken thighs or drumsticks, 2 medium potatoes, 2 medium carrots, 1 large onion, 3 cloves garlic, 2 tablespoons each of gochujang, soy sauce, gochugaru and brown sugar, 1 teaspoon black pepper, 2 cups chicken broth and 2 tablespoons sesame oil, cooked for 20 minutes at high pressure.

The assistant recommended Sempio and Koko as brands of Korean chili flakes (gochugaru), and Sunchang and Chongga as brands of gochujang, noting they can be found at Asian markets or online retailers such as Amazon.

The user said they were concerned about spiciness because they had never cooked with gochujang, and asked how spicy the Korean Chicken Stew would be with the recommended amounts of gochujang and chili flakes.

The assistant estimated gochujang at roughly 1,000 to 3,000 SHU and gochugaru at roughly 10,000 to 20,000 SHU, and said the Korean Chicken Stew with 2 tablespoons of each would be moderate to medium-hot.

The assistant suggested the user could reduce the chili flakes to 1 tablespoon, omit them, or add them in 1/2 teaspoon increments to taste, since heat is hard to remove once it has been added to a dish.
The user decided to start with 1 tablespoon of chili flakes in the Korean Chicken Stew, and asked whether chicken breast could be used instead of thighs or drumsticks.

The assistant said chicken breast can replace thighs or drumsticks in the Korean Chicken Stew if cut into 1-2 inch pieces and cooked for 10-12 minutes at high pressure, checked to reach 165 F (74 C), though the texture may be drier.

On 21 May 2023 the user asked for healthy meal ideas using beans and lentils, mentioning they had recently made chili con carne, and the assistant suggested Black Bean and Sweet Potato Enchiladas, a Cuban Black Bean and Rice Bowl, and White Bean and Spinach Stew.

The assistant also suggested Indian-Style Red Lentil Curry, Lentil and Vegetable Stew, Lentil and Mushroom Bolognese, Vegan Chili, Bean and Lentil Chili and Frijoles Refritos as bean and lentil meal ideas.
The user got a new Air Fryer on 20 May 2023 and wanted to use it to make crispy sweet potato fries to go with the bean and lentil meals.

The assistant's Air Fryer tips for sweet potato fries include cutting them into 1/2 inch (1 cm) strips, soaking them in cold water for at least 30 minutes and patting them dry, cooking at 400 F (200 C) for 12-15 minutes while shaking halfway, avoiding overcrowding, using only a light spray of oil, and seasoning after cooking.
The user planned to make the Cuban Black Bean and Rice Bowl with sweet potato fries and asked for a simple dessert to round out the meal.

The assistant suggested three desserts: a fresh fruit salad of strawberries, grapes, kiwi and pineapple with lime juice, sugar and mint; a coconut lime Greek yogurt parfait with honey and toasted coconut; and banana nice cream made from frozen bananas.
The user chose the fresh fruit salad dessert for the Cuban Black Bean and Rice Bowl meal, saying it sounded super refreshing and easy to make.

The assistant advised that cooked leftovers from the Cuban Black Bean and Rice Bowl can be refrigerated in airtight, shallow containers for 3 to 5 days, or frozen for 3 to 6 months after cooling to room temperature, and should be reheated to 165 F (74 C).

The assistant advised storing sweet potato fries at room temperature for up to 24 hours, refrigerating them in an airtight container for up to 3 days, or freezing them for up to 3 months after freezing them in a single layer on a parchment-lined baking sheet.
The assistant advised reheating frozen sweet potato fries at 400 F (200 C) in the oven for 10-15 minutes, or in the Air Fryer in batches for about 5-7 minutes while shaking halfway, until crispy.

The assistant gave these prices for guitar learning sites: Guitar Tricks at $19.95/month after a 14-day free trial, Yousician at $19.95/month or $119.88/year, and TrueFire, GuitarLessons365, ArtistWorks and JamPlay at $29.95/month or $299.95/year each.

The user has a Spotify playlist they created called Summer Vibes, which has chill tracks perfect for relaxing or working out, and the user wants a music streaming service for discovering new ambient and lo-fi music and artists.

The assistant recommended Bandcamp, Apple Music, Tidal and Deezer for discovering ambient and lo-fi music, citing Apple Music's Moods section and New Music Mix playlist, Tidal's human-curated Discover feature and Rising section, and Deezer's AI-based Discover feature.

The assistant suggested Spotify playlists Lo-Fi Girl (over 2 million followers), Ambient Universe, Chillhop Music and Coffee Shop Jazz, plus Spotify's Discover Weekly and Release Radar, and the Reddit communities WeAreTheMusicMakers and Music for discovering new music.
The user said they had been listening to podcasts a lot and asked for inspiring entrepreneurial stories or business-related podcasts.

The assistant recommended business podcasts The Hustle, Planet Money (NPR), The $100 MBA, HBR IdeaCast (Harvard Business Review), The Entrepreneur's Journey, The Dave Ramsey Show, The Social Media Marketing Podcast, The Marketing Companion, The Profit First Podcast and The Growth Lab (HubSpot).

The assistant recommended beginner YouTube guitar channels Justin Guitar, Marty Music and GuitarLessons365, intermediate to advanced channels GuitarJamz, Andy Guitar and Ben Eller Guitar, and specialist channels Fingerstyle Guitar, GuitarJamz Acoustic and LickLibrary.

The assistant said it has no real-time access to location-based information and suggested finding local music festivals and concerts through Songkick, Bandsintown, Eventbrite, Facebook Events, local music blogs, venue websites and festival websites.

The assistant described The Lumineers as a foot-stomping, folk-infused rock band and The 1975 as blending indie rock with pop and electronica, and asked the user which songs or performances stood out at the festival.

The user, who is trying to read more diversely, finished The Hate U Give by Angie Thomas a few days before a book club meeting around 8 May 2023, having been the only member who had not yet finished the book.

The assistant recommended books similar to The Hate U Give: Dear Martin by Nic Stone, The Poet X by Elizabeth Acevedo, Long Way Down by Jason Reynolds, All American Boys by Jason Reynolds and Brendan Kiely, and The Sun is Also a Star by Nicola Yoon.

The assistant recommended authors Jason Reynolds, Nicola Yoon, Renee Watson (Piecing Me Together, Betty Before X), Ibi Zoboi (American Street, Pride) and Dhonielle Clayton (The Belles, Shattered Midnight).

Over the weekend of 20-21 May 2023 the user finished three fiction novels, The Seven Husbands of Evelyn Hugo, The Silent Patient and The Nightingale, and asked whether the recommended authors would appeal to someone who enjoys a mix of genres and styles.

The assistant matched The Seven Husbands of Evelyn Hugo to Nicola Yoon (The Sun is Also a Star, Everything, Everything), The Silent Patient to Jason Reynolds (Long Way Down, Look Both Ways), and The Nightingale to Renee Watson (Piecing Me Together, Betty Before X).
The assistant suggested further authors for eclectic tastes: Tomi Adeyemi (Children of Blood and Bone), Sabaa Tahir (An Ember in the Ashes) and Nnedi Okorafor (Who Fears Death, Binti).
The user has started listening to audiobooks during a daily commute and has finished Sapiens: A Brief History of Humankind by Yuval Noah Harari and Daisy Jones and The Six by Taylor Jenkins Reid.
The assistant listed audiobook platforms Audible, Libro.fm (which partners with independent bookstores), Scribd, and free access through public libraries via OverDrive or Hoopla.

The user said they prefer full-cast audiobook narrations for novels with multiple characters and dialogue-heavy scenes, while also enjoying single narrators who bring a unique tone and style to a story.

The assistant suggested audiobooks with strong narration: The Hate U Give (narrated by Bahni Turpin), The Night Circus (Jim Dale), The Power (Adjoa Andoh), The Song of Achilles (Frazer Douglas), and The First Fifteen Lives of Harry August (Peter Kenny).

The assistant named narrators Juliet Stevenson, Scott Brick, George Guidall and Khristine Hvam as well-known audiobook narrators, and suggested checking the Audie Awards to discover more great narrations.
The user said narration is crucial in audiobooks, and that the narrator of The Hate U Give helped keep them engaged and connected with the characters during their book club reading.
